name: Do I need a lawyer if the insurance company offers a settlement for my neck injury?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a lawyer if the insurance company offers a settlement for my neck injury?

acceptedAnswer.text: Even if an insurance company offers a settlement for your neck injury, it's highly recommended to consult with an attorney before accepting. Insurance adjusters often aim to settle cases for the lowest possible amount, which may not fully cover all your current and future medical expenses, lost wages, or pain and suffering. An experienced attorney can evaluate the true value of your claim, negotiate on your behalf, and ensure that any settlement you accept adequately compensates you for all your damages. They understand the tactics used by insurance companies.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, consult an attorney even if offered a settlement; insurance companies often offer less than your claim's full value, and an attorney can negotiate for fair compensation.
